posted_text:
🏥 PR PC1450 — Puerto Rico Could Expand Medicaid Coverage for Low-Income Adults

This bill would allow Puerto Rico to expand Medicaid eligibility to include more low-income adults.

Currently, the bill would remove certain income restrictions for those seeking coverage through the Medicaid program.

The measure would also create a new category of coverage for individuals with disabilities, potentially increasing access to healthcare services for a vulnerable population.

The bill’s passage would require approval by the Puerto Rico Senate and House of Representatives.

Sept. 28, 2026: First Reading in the Senate.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://sutra.oslpr.org/medidas/162331
